findings.description: If `fp.read()` returns a `str` (e.g., a text-mode file), `fdata` will be a string while later processing expects bytes, potentially causing encoding errors.
findings.suggested_fix_hint: Ensure the read data is bytes, e.g., `fdata = fp.read(); if isinstance(fdata, str): fdata = fdata.encode('utf-8')`.

discarded.description: When a file value is a string (interpreted as a file path), the code assigns the path string directly to `fdata` (line 55). This causes the multipart body to contain the literal path instead of the file's contents, and may also raise a TypeError later if the encoder expects bytes. The intended behavior is to read the file's bytes.
discarded.reason: Line 55 is outside changed lines in PR diff

finding.description: If `fp.read()` returns a `str` (e.g., a text-mode file), `fdata` will be a string while later processing expects bytes, potentially causing encoding errors.
finding.suggested_fix_hint: Ensure the read data is bytes, e.g., `fdata = fp.read(); if isinstance(fdata, str): fdata = fdata.encode('utf-8')`.
